questions.question: The third proportional to 0.9 and 0.3 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1st proportional= 0.9

2nd proportional= 0.3

**Formula Used:**

3rd proportional= ((2nd proportional)²)/(1st proportional)

**Calculations:**

According to the formula

⇒ 3rd proportional= ((2nd proportional)²)/(1st proportional)=((0.3)²)/(0.9)=(0.3×0.3)/(0.9)= 0.1

**Hence, The 3rd proportional is 0.1**

questions.question: An employee spends 75% of his income. His income rises by 25%, while his spending rises by 10%. The percentage of increase in his saving is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let, 100 be the initial income.

Now, he spends 75% of it means 75Rs.

**Solution:**

Now, his saving is 100 - 75 = 25Rs =25%

His income rises by 25%= 125Rs.

His spending is increased by 10% = 75 + 10% x 75

⇒ 75 + 7.5 = 82.5Rs 

Hence, the new saving = 125 - 82.5 = 42.5Rs.

Change in savings = 42.5 - 25 = 17.5Rs.

**The Percentage change in savings = 17.5 / 25 = 70%**

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. A begins to do the work and they work alternately, one at a time, for one day each. The whole work will be completed in ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 18 days

A begins to do the work and they work alternately, one at a time, for one day each

**Formula Used:**

Total work= time taken x efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total work = LCM of 12 and 18= 36 

⇒ A can complete work= 12 days

⇒ Work does in one day= (36)/(12) = 3 unit

⇒ B can complete work= 18 days

⇒ Work does in one day= (36)/(18)= 2 unit

As they work for alternate days,

⇒ In 2 days work completed is

⇒ ⇒ 2 days= 3 unit + 2 unit

⇒ 2 days= 5 unit

⇒ 14 days= 35 unit 

⇒ The remaining work = 36 - 35= 1

⇒ On the last day, A has to work= (1)/(3)days

⇒ Total days= 14 days + (1)/(3)days= 14(1)/(3) days

**Hence, The total work is completed in 14(1)/(3) days**

questions.question: The ratio of the two numbers is 5 ∶ 8 and their LCM is 840. What are the two numbers?
questions.solution:

The ratio of the two numbers is 5 ∶ 8

LCM is 840

**Concept Used:**

The concept of LCM is the taking lowest common factor of two or more numbers

**Calculations:**

⇒ The ratio of two numbers = 5: 8

⇒ 1st number= 5a

⇒ 2nd number= 8a

⇒ LCM of two number= 5 x 8 x a=840

⇒ a= 21

⇒ 1st number= 5a= 5 x 21= 105

⇒ 2nd number= 8a= 8 x 21= 168

**Hence, The numbers are 105 and 168**

questions.question: The perimeter of a rectangle and a square are 160 m each. The area of the rectangle is less than that of the square by 100 m². The length of the rectangle is _________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2(l + b) = 4s = 160m

l x b = s x s - 100

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of square = 4 x side = 4 x s

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 x (Lenght + Breadth) = 2(l + b)

Area of square = side x side = s x s

Area of rectangle= l x b

**Solution:**

4 x s = 160

s = 160 / 4 = 40m

Side of the square = 40m

Now,

2l + 2b = 160

l + b = 80

l = 80 - b

l x b = 1600 - 100

l x b = 1500

80b - b² = 1500

b2 - 80b + 1500 = 0

b = {80 pm { sqrt { 80² - (4 times 1 times 1500)}}} over { 2 times 1}

b = {80 pm { sqrt { 6400 - 6000}}} over { 2}

b = {80 pm { sqrt 400}} over { 2} = {80 pm 20} over { 2} 

b = 100/2 = 50m or b = 60/2 = 30m

**Hence, the length = 80 - 30 = 50m.**

questions.question: A dishonest shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at cost price, but he uses a weight of 900 g for the kg weight. Find the gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

shopkeper used 900g instead of 1000g.

**Formula used:**

Gain percent = [(Selling Price - Cost price) /Cost price] x 100

**Solution:**

Let, selling price for 1000g = m

Now, the cost price for 900g = m - 0.1m = 0.9m

Gain percent = [(m - 0.9m)/0.9m] x 100 = (1/9) x 100 = 11.11%

**Hence, the gain % is 11.11%**

questions.question: A thief steals a car at 3:30 A.M. and drives it at 64 km/h. The thief is discovered at 4:30 A.M. and the owner starts the chase with another car at 80 km/h. When will he catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Theif steals at 3:30am

Theif discovered at 4:30am

Theif speed = 64km/h

Owner speed= 80km/h

**Defination used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Solution:**

In one hour thief will cover distance = 64km

Relative speed of thief and owner = 80 - 64 = 16km/h 

The owner will reach to thief in 64/16 = 4 hours.

Hence, 4:30 am + 4 hours = 8:30am.

**Hence, the owner will catch the thief at 8:30am.**

questions.question: If 10% of an electricity bill is deducted, Rs. 45 is still to be paid. The bill amount is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

10% of an electricity bill is deducted

Rs. 45 is still to be paid

**Formula Used:**

Percentage= P x (R)/(100)

**Calculations:**

Let the total amount = Rs. a

⇒ 10% of a= a x (R)/(100)= a x (10)/(100)= (a)/(10)

According to the question,

⇒ a - (a)/(10)= Rs. 45

⇒ (10a-a)/(10)= 45

⇒ 9a= 450

⇒ a= 50

**Hence, The original amount of the bill is Rs. 50**

questions.question: A 315 - m - long train is moving at a speed of 24 km/h. It will cross a man coming from the opposite direction at a speed of 3 km/h in __________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Lenght of train = 315m

Speed of train = 24km/h

Speed of man = 3km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Relative speed = Addition of speeds if moving in opposite direction.

**Solution:**

Relative speed of man and train = 24 + 3 = 27km/h

27km/h = 27000m/(60x 60)s = 7.5m/s

**Now, time to cover the distance = 315/7.5 = 42 seconds.**

questions.question: Ramesh purchased watches at the rate of Rs. 600 each from a wholesaler. He raised the price by 25% and then allowed a discount of 12% on each watch. What was his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = Rs. 600

Price raised = 25%

Discount = 12%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) x 100

**Solution:**

On raising the price by 25%, the cost becomes 600 + (0.25 x 600) 

⇒ Selling price = 600 + 150 = Rs. 750

Now, he gives a 12% discount means the marked price = 750 - (0.12 x 750)

⇒ Marked price = 750 - 90 = Rs. 660

Now, the original profit = [(660 - 600) / 600] x 100 = 10%

**Hence, the profit percent will be 10%.**

questions.question: ABC Ltd is selling laptops across the nation. The manager said that the company earned a profit of the sale price of 1008 laptops on the sale of 6608 laptops in a year. What is the gain percentage that the company earned?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The company earned a profit from the sale price of 1008 laptops on the sale of 6608 laptops in a year

**Formula Used:**

Gain%= (Gain)/(CP)×100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Sales of laptop= 6608 laptops

⇒ Profit earned= 1008 laptops

⇒ CP of laptops sells= 6608 - 1008= 5600 laptops

According to the formula,

⇒ Gain%= (Gain)/(CP)×100=(1008)/(5600)×100=(1008)/(56) = 18%

**Hence, The gain earned by the company is 18%**

questions.question: A tradesman marks his goods at 30% above the cost price. If he allows the customers a 10% discount, how much percentage does he make as profit?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Marked price of goods are at 30% above the cost price

Discount% is 10%

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = ( 1- d/100) × M.P. 

Profit = ( S.P. - C.P.)

Profit% = ( Profit / C.P.) × 100 

Where, S.P. = Selling Price , M.P.= Marked Price , D = Discount 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the Cost Price to be Rs100

Then, according to the given question,

⇒ Marked Price = 30% above the cost price 

⇒ Marked Price = 100 + 100 × 30/100 = ( 100 + 30) = 130 

Now, 

⇒ S.P. = ( 1- d/100) × M.P. 

⇒ S.P. = ( 1 - 10/100) × 130 = 90/100 × 130 = 117

⇒ Profit = ( S.P. - C.P.) = ( 117 - 100 ) = 17

Profit% = ( Profit/C.P.) × 100 = (17/100) × 100 = 17%

**Hence, Profit% is 17% .**

questions.question: The population of a town 2 years ago was 8000. If the population growth rate is 30% per annum. What will the population after 1 year ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The population of a town 2 years ago was 8000

If the population growth rate is 30% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Population after increased = P x ((100+R))/(100)

**Calculations:**

⇒ The population of town before 2 years= 8000

⇒ The population of town before 1 years= P x ((100+R))/(100)= 8000 x ((100+30))/(100)= 80 x 130= 10400

⇒ The population of town present= P x ((100+R))/(100)= 10400 x ((100+30))/(100)= 104 x 130= 13520

⇒ The population of town after 1 years= P x ((100+R))/(100)= 13520 x ((100+30))/(100)= 135.2 x 130= 17576

**Hence, The population of the town after 1 year is 17576.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Here, 30% = 3/10 i.e. 3 units increase out of 10 units.

Total increase = 13/10 units

Let the present population of town = P

⇒ 8000 × 13/10 × 13/10 = P

⇒ P = 13520

Population of after 1 year = 13520 × 13/10 = 17576
